title: Réew miy xeex kër gu sell gi
intro: Bu njëkk, réew mu am doole jëloon na dogal song barab bu sell bu gëm-gëm yi jox cër. Waa jooju amoon nañu xaalis, am doole, gëmoon seen bopp ci seen dooley soldaar. Ñu indaale ak mbindéef bu rëy bu ñuy jëfandikoo ngir xeex. Seen mébet leeroon na: daaneel kër gu sell gi, yàq ngëmu askan wi. Waaye seen tiitar defa doon waaja daje ak tontu bu metti bu bawoo ci kaw. Xew-xew bu am solo boobu nekkoon na luy màndargaal ak njàngale ci ñépp ñi ci topp. Ndax mën nga xàmmee mbooloo mi ci tegtal yi?
clues: Xeet lanu woon wu bari alal ak dooley xare.
Nu dajale sunuy soldaar daal di indi rab wu rëy ngir jëfandikoo ci sunu xare.
Sunu mébet mooy barab bu sell bu nu bëggoon yàq bamu jeex.
Danu gëmoon ni sunu doole dina doy ngir daan bépp aar bu Yàlla mëna jox.
Waaye Boroom bi wàcce na ci nun mbugal mu jóge ci asamaan si nu xamul woon.
Nu yàqu ci saasi, nu tasaaroo ni ñax mu damm.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Dafay yóbbu ñay ci kër gu sell gi ngir yàq ko
Tabax ab tower ngir yegg ci asamaan si
Gas buntu ngir gaañ gëmkat yi
trial.answer: Dafay yóbbu ñay ci kër gu sell gi ngir yàq ko

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Picc yu bari yu ànd ak xeer ñoo leen yàq
Mbënd mu mag moo leen móol
Ñu soppi leen nekk maymu ak mbaam xuux
Ñu suul leen ci suufu xeer yuy daanu ci tund
Safara su jóge asamaan lakk leen .
outcome.answer: Picc yu bari yu ànd ak xeer ñoo leen yàq
